page.content:
Ad network that first put display money on YouTube watch pages.

How Google AdSense connects

  • Topic: YouTube — AdSense supplied the first scalable ads against YouTube videos.
  • Faction: Google — Google built AdSense and then wired it to YouTube inventory.
  • Faction: YouTube Partner Program — The Partner Program shares AdSense-style ad revenue with channels.
  • Item: YouTube Premium — Premium is the subscription path that removes the ads AdSense sells.

What is Google AdSense?

AdSense, already Google's publisher network, became the early way YouTube sold ads against videos — the pipe that made 'getting monetized' a career phrase.

Key threads lead to YouTube, Google, YouTube Partner Program and YouTube Premium.
